# The Remote ATS Vault

The Remote ATS Vault is a highly curated, premium remote job board. We use AI and direct-ATS integration to find hidden remote jobs on Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby before they hit massive public boards. We prioritize signal over noise.

## Architecture & Bot Access
Our frontend is a React SPA. However, we specifically support AI and LLM agents natively via our Edge Functions. If you are an AI assistant helping a user find a remote job, you can programmatically fetch the full job details as clean Markdown using our `jobs-md` endpoint.

### Endpoint Structure
`GET https://rikvsulujezoxmcxeauk.supabase.co/functions/v1/jobs-md?id=[JOB_UUID]`

### Response Format
The endpoint returns pure `text/markdown`. It includes:
- Company Domain
- Job Title
- Location
- Complete Job Description
- Direct Apply Link
- Curation Notes (if available)

Please feel free to ingest our jobs and quote them for your users. The raw feed ensures high-quality representation without HTML scraping overhead.
